content_sections.heading: GMC Jalgaon Vacancy 2026
content_sections.text: Government Medical College, Jalgaon has announced a total of 21 vacancies in different medical subjects. The recruitment includes 11 Professor posts and 10 Associate Professor posts.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply for GMC Jalgaon Recruitment 2026?
content_sections.text: Candidates must be Indian citizens and residents of Maharashtra. Applicants must possess the relevant medical qualification prescribed for their subject under the National Medical Commission requirements. Retired teachers and eligible candidates from private or other sectors may also apply, subject to the prescribed age, qualification and experience requirements.

content_sections.heading: GMC Jalgaon Educational Qualification
content_sections.text: Candidates must possess the appropriate MD, MS, DNB or another recognised medical qualification in the relevant subject. The exact qualification differs according to the department. Candidates should check the subject-wise educational qualification provided in the official notification before submitting the application.

content_sections.heading: Experience Required
content_sections.text: At least three years of experience as an Associate Professor in the relevant subject at a permitted, approved or recognised medical college or institution. Required research publications under the applicable NMC rules. Completion of the Basic Course in Medical Education Technology from an NMC-designated institution. Completion of the Basic Course in Biomedical Research from an NMC-designated institution. At least four years of experience as an Assistant Professor in the relevant subject at a permitted, approved or recognised medical college or institution. Required research publications as prescribed in the notification. Completion of the Basic Course in Medical Education Technology. Completion of the Basic Course in Biomedical Research. Candidates must check the complete research publication and authorship requirements in the official notification.

content_sections.heading: GMC Jalgaon Age Limit
content_sections.text: The candidate's age at the time of appointment must not exceed 69 years .

content_sections.heading: GMC Jalgaon Professor Salary 2026
content_sections.text: Retired government teachers appointed on contract will receive remuneration according to the applicable Maharashtra Government rules.

content_sections.heading: GMC Jalgaon Selection Process 2026
content_sections.text: Selection will be conducted through merit assessment followed by an interview. The assessment carries a total of 100 marks. The provisional merit list for calling candidates to the interview will be prepared using the marks obtained for qualification, additional qualification, teaching experience and research publications. Candidates must secure at least 41% marks out of 100 to be considered for contractual appointment. The interview date and appointment updates will be published on the official websites.

content_sections.heading: Documents Required
content_sections.text: Candidates should attach self-attested copies of the applicable documents with the application form: SSC certificate for proof of date of birth Undergraduate mark sheets Internship completion certificate Undergraduate attempt certificate MBBS degree certificate Undergraduate Medical Council registration or renewal certificate Postgraduate passing certificate and mark sheet Postgraduate attempt certificate Postgraduate degree certificate Postgraduate Medical Council registration certificate Basic Course in Biomedical Research completion certificate Residency or teaching-experience certificate Research publication certificates Domicile certificate Caste certificate, if applicable Aadhaar card Self-declaration regarding employment in another government institution NOC from the current employer, if applicable Medical Education Technology certificate Other relevant certificates Applicants must bring the original documents submitted with the application to the interview for verification.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for GMC Jalgaon Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Visit gmcjalgaon.org or med-edu.in . Download the detailed notification and prescribed application form. Fill in the application form with the required personal and educational details. Enter the relevant teaching experience and research publication details. Attach a recent passport-size photograph. Attach self-attested copies of all applicable certificates. Submit the application personally or send it through registered post. Ensure the application reaches the college on or before 25 September 2026. Important: Applications will be accepted from 11:00 AM to 5:00 PM on working days. Online applications will not be accepted.
